_comment: Claude API list prices in USD per million tokens, the one table every spend figure in Pythia comes from (pythia-core ai_budget.rs compiles it in). input/output are the published rates; cacheWrite (5-minute cache) and cacheRead follow the published multipliers (1.25x and 0.1x of input) except where the price list names its own figure. Haiku 5.5 bills a higher rate once a prompt is longer than longAbove tokens. Batch requests cost batchDiscount of these rates. A model not listed here is costed at the most expensive row, so an unknown name can never look cheap.
